senses.gloss: f. (= חססית; חסס, cmp. Ar. ḥassa) peeling plants, alliacea, leek plants.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Terumot 10:10">Ter. X, 10</cite> <he>אלא עם הח׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>החִיסוֹת</he>; Y. ed. <he>החִיסִית</he>) except they are combined with leek-plants. Y. ib. 47ᵇ <he>ח׳ בח׳ מין במינו</he> if the same species of leek plants (of T’rumah and Ḥullin) are pressed together.
<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 2">Lam. R. to II, 11</cite>, v. <cite ref="D00911"><he>דִּמְעָה</he></cite>.—Pl. <he>חָסִיּוֹת</he>.

<cite ref="Tosefta Terumot 9:3">Tosef. Ter. IX, 3</cite> <he>אלו הן מיני ח׳ וכ׳</he> (ed. Zuck. <he>חרסיות</he>, Var. <he>חוריות</he>, <he>חסיות</he>) the following belong to the leek-plants, common leek, garlic, onion and allium porrum, v. <cite ref="S01753"><he>קַפְלוֹט</he></cite>.
